title: Stabilizer Splitting for Epipelagic Data
body_html:
Stabilizer Splitting for Epipelagic Data

For epipelagic data \((x,\lambda)\), the finite stabilizer quotient \(S_{x,\lambda}\) splits inside the full stabilizer \(H_{x,\lambda}\). Equivalently, \[ H_{x,\lambda}=S_{x,\lambda}G_{x,1/m}. \]

This splitting lets one add a stabilizer character \(\chi\) to the stable functional \(\lambda\), producing the epipelagic representation \(\pi_x(\lambda,\chi)\).
proof_html:
Extraction

The proof uses the Reeder-Yu construction of epipelagic representations. The stabilizer of the stable functional acts through a finite reductive quotient, while the Moy-Prasad subgroup \(G_{x,1/m}\) contributes the character determined by \(\lambda\). Stability forces the relevant stabilizer quotient to be finite and gives the required complement.
